sharedPrompt.assetType: Production master sprite atlas for a 2D side-scrolling alien hunting game
sharedPrompt.request: Create an exact 5-row by 6-column atlas. Each row is one completely original enemy family. Each row shows the same creature in six consistent right-facing gameplay poses in this exact order: idle, locomotion A, locomotion B, attack, hit recoil, collapsed death.
sharedPrompt.style: Highly detailed dark cinematic hand-painted pixel-art-like game sprites, realistic organic or material textures, strong readable silhouettes, side-view, consistent identity and scale within each row.
sharedPrompt.composition: Exact regular 5x6 grid, 30 subjects total. Every subject is fully visible inside its own equal cell with generous empty margin. No overlap, no crossing cell boundaries, no grid lines.
sharedPrompt.constraints: Uniform #ff00ff only, no gradient, texture, shadow, ground, reflection or vignette. Crisp isolated opaque silhouettes. Do not use magenta in subjects. No detached particles or projectiles. No text, labels, icons, borders, watermark or recognizable franchise character. Original designs only.
